messages:
Maya R: quick question — i'm about to enable request+response body logging in staging for a 30m run to debug the KV-cache mismatch that drops context. will only run under a feature flag. posting samples below for redaction review. @samk @jonahl :eyes:
Sam K: share the exact sample logs you plan to capture?
Maya R: sure — example snippet (sanitized):
```
REQUEST HEADER: {"Authorization":"Bearer sk-live-2b7f...", "X-User-Email":"alice@example.com"}
REQUEST BODY: {"prompt":"Summarize user message: 'My SSN is 123-45-6789'", "session_id":"sess_abc123"}
RESPONSE BODY: {"completion":"...", "cache_key":"kv_0x9f..."}
```
Maya R: requirements i think: redact Authorization header token, redact emails and any SSN-like patterns in bodies, mask session_id and cache_key. store logs in a restricted staging bucket with 24h retention.
Alex P: agreed — regex + structured scrub should do it. for headers: /Authorization:\s*Bearer\s+\S+/ -> replace with "[REDACTED_TOKEN]". for bodies: run two passes — pii regex (emails, ssn) then a key whitelist for fields we allow unmasked. add a hash of session_id instead of raw.
Sam K: +1 on approach. couple of asks: (1) only allow devs: @maya, @alex, @sam, and @jonah to access; (2) audit log of who read the bucket; (3) ensure redaction step runs before any file leaves the host (no raw payloads to S3).
Jonah L: i can approve temporary access for staging infra. one note: we need a short incident ticket and code review with the scrub implementation. put the scrub code in a separate PR and mark logs as "debug-ephemeral".
Maya R: created ticket infra/1234 and PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/489 — PR includes the scrub middleware and tests. PR text notes the regex and retention policy.
security-bot: Reminder: Per logging policy, PII must be removed before persisting. Temporary debug logs require a designated approver and 24h retention max.
Alex P: can we also add a small unit test showing SSN/email/token redaction so reviewers can validate?
Maya R: yes i'll add tests to PR this morning. Sam — can you review the scrub rules?
Sam K: will review in next hour. if all good i approve access for the 30m window.
Jonah L: approved for access window 2026-03-18T15:00Z -> 15:30Z. make sure the feature flag flips back off automatically.
Maya R: noted. i'll enable, run debug, then post findings and confirm logs deleted after 24h. thanks all. :thumbsup:
